description.text:
The deck that won the 15 and up division of the 2004 World Championships without losing a match. It is full of Team Magma Pokémon, with plenty of search cards to bring out Team Magma's Groudon; Team Magma decks from Japan won all three age divisions that year. The 2004 World Championships, the first run by Pokémon Organized Play rather than Wizards of the Coast, were held at the Wyndham Palace Resort & Spa at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida, from 20 to 22 August 2004.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2004 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
